turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, I am Rajesh from the electronics logistics team. I have a large parcel here for you in Nagpur.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Logistics? I am not expecting any parcel today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is the high-end television set, sir. The invoice shows a total value of twenty five thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the one my son ordered for my birthday! Yes, that is correct.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. I am currently near the Hanuman Temple area, is your house nearby?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, it is just two streets away. But I am not sure if the gate is open.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem sir, I can wait for ten minutes. Just let me know if I should call you again when I reach the gate.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, please do. I will tell my wife to keep the door open.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect, Mr. Patil. I will see you in a few minutes then.
